DILG DAOONO Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City wwwxlilq qov OILG OPINION NO. S. JUL 2 8 2025 ATTY. RICKA MARIE P. GOCO City Councilor Calapan City, Mindoro Dear Atty. Goco: This has reference to the electronic mail dated 12 December 2024 endorsed by the Bureau of Local Government Supervision (BLGS) to this level pertaining to your request for Travel Authority for a personal travel abroad last December 18-25, 2024. Culled from this letter are the following facts, to wit: The Application for Travel Authority was filed last 29 October 2024 with the Clearance Form. The Acting City Administrator/City Legal Officer required a clearance from the Ombudsman certifying that you have no pending case as a prerequisite of the Travel and Clearance for Travel Abroad. You filed a Reconsideration to the additional prerequisite for your travel abroad. Consequently, the City Mayor sent you a letter regarding the requirement of an Affidavit of Undertaking that your foreign travel will not hamper or cause any delay to the approval of the annual budget for the year 2025. You reiterate that you are not a flight risk, will not evade any legal proceedings and the purpose of the travel is to celebrate your union with your husband We discuss. Pursuant to DILG 2022-1471 and considering your current position, it is the local chief executive who exercises discretion and authority to approve requests for personal travel not less than three (3) months and when there is no emergency crisis. It is significant to note that under Annex A of the subject MC, the basic documents on all travel categories require only the following, to wit: (l) Citizen's Charter Service Request Form, (2) Request Letter; (3) Notarized Affidavit attesting that no administrative charge or criminal case or is pending against the applicant, or Oath of Undertaking when the applicant has a pending case; and (4) Accomplished Clearance from Money and Property Accountabilities. Based on the foregoing, the additional requirement for an Ombudsman Clearance is not consistent with this Department's issuance. It is also clear that in cases where a 1 AMENDATORY GUIDELINES ON DILG MEMORANDUM CIRCULAR NO. 2022-134 RELATIVE TO THE APPLICATION OF FOREIGN TRAVEL AUTHORITY OF LOCAL OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES. dated 22 November 2022.

ng case is filed before any local elective official, an Oath of Undertaking will ffire. t is also important to emphasize that when the application for leave of absence is not acted upon within five (5) working days after receipt thereof, the application for leave of absence shall be deemed approved, as provided for in Section 47, Approval of Leaves of Absence of the Local Government Code of 1991.2 Further, in case of political conflict or issue, When a local chief executive concerned failed to act within the prescribed period under the Local Government Code of 1991, on a request for an authority to travel of any local official or employee, the Secretary of the Interior and Local Government may issue a Department Authorization as part of his supervisory power, and in adherence to the Constitutional provision protecting the right of a person to travel under Section 6, Chapter VII, 1987 Constitution3. It is clear based from this Department's issuances that the only Grounds for Non- Processing or Disapproval of Request are the following, to wit: (I) incomplete administrative requirements shall not be processed and shall be returned to the concerned party without favorable action; (2) any request submitted less than seven (7) working days prior to the date of departure shall be automatically denied by the system to proceed for the application; (3) no post travel authority shall be issued4. Finally, this opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations narrated from the letter and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you on this matter. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs LLLS/RPBULRALLD/sbl COPY FURNISHED: DEBIE T.
